text: COMBAT - ATTACK
Sometimes violence is the only option. Attack your opponent with your equipped weapon to deal damage to their Health Points (HP). Each weapon type has its own unique dice.
COMBAT - ATTACK
Stay focused. In combat you can confirm critical hits and counter your opponent's attacks.
COMBAT

Combat in Glasshouse isn’t always about being "the last man standing". You can Talk to your opponent and bring them to their senses or Attack and give in the call of violence. Mind the items in you inventory and Use them to obtain an advantage.
COMBAT - USE
You can Use items in your Inventory to gain a tactical advantage over your opponent.
COMBAT - TALK
Select Talk Approaches to lower your opponent’s Threat (TH). The Approaches available are influnced by your Political Build, and each one requires at least 1 POV to use.
COMBAT - TALK
Focus Enemy Beliefs (green): the higher your POV, the easier it is to damage your opponent's Threat (TH). Avoid Enemy Doubts (red): Your opponent's POV is doubled.
COMBAT - TALK
Each time you use a Talk Approach, its dice decreases until it can no longer be used. At the start of each turn, any unused Talk Approach's dice are increased.
COMBAT - TALK
Opponents react differently to each Talk Approach depending on their Political Compass. Talk to them and Find their Weak Points (green).
COMBAT - FORCE SURRENDER

You can Force Surrender when your Threat (TH) is higher than your opponent's. Roll the dice and add the value of your current Threat (TH). If the result is higher than your opponent's Threat, the Force Surrender succeds.
COMBAT - FORCE SURRENDER
End combat without violence by succeeding a Force Surrender roll.
DIALOGUES

Dialogues allow you to interact verbally with characters, examine interactable objects, and explore the world. Your actions and words will shape the unfolding story. Remember that everything you say or do has long-term consequences.
ADVANCED DIALOGUES
Dialogues are not limited to being just words. Depending on the context and situation, they can lead to quick-time-event (QTE), puzzles, and hidden resources.
BLOCKED CHOICES
Some dialogue choices will be temporarily or permanently unavailable. You may need an item, narrative choice or fulfill a specific Political Configuration.
INVENTORY
Your Inventory shows all items and resources you’re carrying. Items can unlock new dialogue options and be used in combat.
INVENTORY
Some items can be used or read. Double-click an item to use it. Your inventory can be upgraded. Find upgrades by completing quests, exploring, or trading.
JOURNAL
Your Journal keeps track of what has happened so far. Wealdmaer is lazy, he won't record all his progress in real time.
CRAFTING BENCH
In Dormitory 73B, everyone is a bit of a tinkerer and Wealdmaer is no exception. The Crafting Bench allows you to check your Knowledge Tab and craft items for your adventure.
KNOWLEDGE TAB

The Knowledge Tab is a collection of all the recipes you know, allowing you to craft new tools or gadgets. By exploring, interacting with characters, and/or trading, you will obtain new recipes to expand your Knowledge.
CRAFTING
To build an item, choose a recipe from the Knowledge tab. Make sure you have all the necessary materials with you, then click Build.
LIBRARY
The Library section contains all the documents, books, and readable items you have collected along the way. Consult it from time to time to find out more about the Middle Moor culture.
BASIC MOVEMENT
INTERACTION
HIGHLIGHTS
Welcome, comrades, to the world of GLASSHOUSE. Left-click on a walkable surface to start exploring.
Something caught your eye? You can interact with furniture, tapestries, doors, etc... and even with people. Just Left-click on any highlighted object.
The world is full of interesting things, maybe too many and some can easily slip away... Use Right-click or Tab to highlight all interactable objects.
POLITICAL COMPASS

The Political Compass is your beacon of values and virtues in the turbulent sea of political realities. Based on your choices and the POVs you spend, it shows your current Political Build. Points of View (POV) can be spent on the four main ideologies: Feudcratism, Holisticism, Confeudcratism, and Colonialism. Anarchy increases automatically with the ideology with fewer POVs.
POLITICAL CHECKS
The reality of the world can be shaped through your Political Build which influences dialogue options, your physical approach to the world and also combat.
YOUR STASH

Stashes are storage units scattered throughout the game world. They use a similar system to the PPTS to be connected, so that you can retrieve items regardless of the box where they were initially deposited. They are used to store, manage, and free up space in your inventory.
ITEM MOVEMENT
You can drag items manually, or Right-click to quickly move them in between containers.
Some items can be used or read. Press X on an item to use it. Your inventory can be upgraded. Find upgrades by completing quests, exploring, or trading.
